en-US.longDescription: A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
en-US.name: Ghost Downloader
en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
Following this release, updates will be less frequent due to my studies. Thank you for your understanding. Feedback is always welcome.
Buy me a coffee: Donate
New Features 🎉
- Download completion and other notices can appear as a popup in the bottom-right corner, where you can open the file or its folder directly. Switch between Popup, System Notification and Off in Settings. Popups are not available on Wayland or macOS (#500) By @XiaoYouChR
Improvements 🔧
- On KDE Plasma, the main window and dialogs now have a window shadow, on both Wayland and X11 By @XiaoYouChR
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed the whole desktop freezing after launch on KDE Plasma Wayland (#1045) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed dragging inside the window on Wayland sometimes resizing it By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the ghd command only bringing up the main window instead of running in the Linux and macOS packages By @XiaoYouChR
- On Windows, fixed file types still opening with Ghost Downloader after their association was turned off. Types you've already assigned to another app are left untouched By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed system notifications playing no sound on Windows and KDE Plasma By @XiaoYouChR
Note
此次更新后, 由于本人学业原因, 将放缓更新节奏, 敬请谅解. 欢迎继续提供反馈.
请我喝杯咖啡: 捐赠项目
新功能 🎉
- 下载完成等提示可在右下角以弹窗显示, 可直接打开文件或所在文件夹. 可在设置中切换弹窗、系统通知或关闭. Wayland 和 macOS 上不支持弹窗 (#500) By @XiaoYouChR
功能优化 🔧
- KDE Plasma 下主窗口和对话框显示窗口阴影, Wayland 和 X11 均支持 By @XiaoYouChR
问题修复 🐛
- 修复 KDE Plasma Wayland 下启动后整个桌面卡住的问题 (#1045) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Wayland 下拖动窗口内容时误触发调整窗口大小的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Linux 和 macOS 打包版 ghd 命令只唤起主窗口、不执行命令的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Windows 上关闭文件关联后, 对应文件类型仍由 Ghost Downloader 打开的问题. 已改用其他程序打开的文件类型不受影响 By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Windows 和 KDE Plasma 上系统通知没有提示音的问题 By @XiaoYouChR
